title: What if you could rob a bank and never get caught
description: An original fictional magical thought experiment, not real robbery instructions. Maya guides a discussion; Leo imagines having a magical rule that prevents anyone from catching him; Officer Max challenges the idea. Start in an adult classroom, walk into an outdoor field, imagine a bank lobby, show police physically chasing Leo along a street, pause in a cafe where a character actually lifts and drinks a cup, return the bag in person, and finish in the classroom with a concrete payoff about trust and consequences. Use all three voices, several sustained running/chase and walking shots, carried bag contact and a handoff. No violence, weapons, practical theft methods, security details, or evasion tactics. This is a moving cartoon story, not a line of stationary presenters.
